name: City of Quito
description: Quito, Ecuador's capital, sits high in the Andes at 2,850 metres, in a valley beneath the Pichincha volcano. Its colonial centre, built over an Inca city, is among the best preserved in Latin America. Wander its steep lanes to find the richly decorated churches and monasteries of San Francisco, Santo Domingo and La Compañía, where Spanish, Moorish, Flemish and indigenous art blend.
